description: Experienced investor matched to global equity ETF — all rules pass
client_narrative: Lars Eriksson is 42 years old and works as a portfolio manager. He earns a gross salary of 7,500 euros per month. He holds 150,000 euros in liquid savings and wants to invest 100,000 euros with a long-term horizon. Over the past decade he has actively traded options, futures, and structured leveraged products in addition to equities and ETFs. He rates his own risk tolerance at 7 out of 10 — he is fully comfortable with significant volatility and accepts that his portfolio could suffer substantial losses in a bear market. He has confirmed in writing that he can afford to lose the entire invested amount if that outcome occurs.
product_narrative: The product is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the MSCI World Index, providing diversified exposure to approximately 1,500 large and mid-cap equities across 23 developed markets. The fund is listed on major European exchanges, trades intraday with high liquidity, publishes a KID, contains no embedded derivatives, and uses no leverage. The recommended minimum investment horizon is five years.
